purpose: Manual benchmark scaffold for evaluating deterministic Software Engineer recommendations before adding more ranking complexity.
notes: These cases are AI-assisted drafts reviewed for file structure, catalog consistency, tag validity, and obvious recommendation-rule issues.
The project owner has reviewed these draft cases as acceptable for initial local benchmarking.
Do not treat labels as expert ground truth until an adviser, lecturer, TA, senior student, or another trusted reviewer approves them.
Keep cases stable so old and new recommender versions can be compared on the same inputs.
The frontend does not read this file. It is for offline evaluation planning and later tooling.

cases.description: Y4 CSC student with no topic preferences. Two SC4xxx MPE slots open. Tests that CURRENT_SEMESTER_BONUS=3 acts as a modest tie-breaker, not the primary relevance driver. Both current and non-current modules are labelled 'relevant' to reflect that availability alone does not determine recommendation quality.

Labelled relevant, not highly-relevant, because with no stated preferences, application security is a good but not exceptional default choice; the computer-security career-skill score (6.0) is lower than backend-engineering (8.5). The current-semester bonus should make this slightly more likely to be selected over a similar-quality module that is not currently offered, but should not dominate ranking.
